rationale: The revised plan addresses the three critical feedback items from the evaluation. (1) denial_code_ranking scope changed from 'all_claims' to 'denied_claims' so denial codes are ranked as shares of denied claims only, with shares summing to 1, directly addressing T4-code_ranking feedback. (2) denial_rate_by_segment denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to use only adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator, addressing both T4-segment_rates and the critical T4-segment_denominator feedback on statistical discipline. All other parameters and components remain unchanged as they continue to meet the task objective and produce all required artifacts with appropriate caveats.
changes_summary: Two parameter changes to address evaluation feedback: (1) denial_code_ranking scope: 'all_claims' → 'denied_claims' to rank codes as shares of denials only; (2) denial_rate_by_segment denominator: 'all_claims' → 'adjudicated_claims' to use adjudicated claims as denominator per statistical discipline requirement.
